scripts.build-win: powershell -Command "$env:npm_config_target='37.1.0'; $env:npm_config_arch='x64'; $env:npm_config_runtime='electron'; $env:npm_config_disturl='https://electronjs.org/headers'; node-gyp rebuild; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ../electron_app/native_modules; Copy-Item build/Release/myaddon.node ../electron_app/native_modules/"
scripts.build-mac: export npm_config_target=37.1.0 npm_config_arch=x64 npm_config_runtime=electron npm_config_disturl=https://electronjs.org/headers && node-gyp rebuild && mkdir -p ../electron_app/native_modules && cp build/Release/myaddon.node ../electron_app/native_modules/
scripts.build: npm run build-win || npm run build-mac
